sections.title: LIC Jeevan Labh Plan 736 / 936 at a Glance

content.text: LIC Jeevan Labh (Table No. 736, formerly Plan 936 and Plan 836) is a non-linked, with-profits, limited premium paying endowment plan. It offers the dual advantage of high financial protection and limited out-of-pocket premium payments.

Simple Reversionary Bonus (SRB) + Final Additional Bonus (FAB)

Deduction under Sec 80C (up to ₹1.5L) & Tax-free maturity under Sec 10(10D)

sections.title: Why Use Our LIC Jeevan Labh Calculator?

content.text: Calculating limited pay insurance premiums manually can be complex. Our interactive actuarial hub satisfies high-intent requirements by computing exact outlays instantly:

items: Limited PPT Visualization: Instantly see how many years of premium payments you save (e.g. pay 16 years for a 25-year policy).
Dual Plan 736/936 Accuracy: Replicates official LIC tabular rates with 1st-year (4.5%) and 2nd-year (2.25%) GST brackets.
Granular Maturity Breakdown: Displays Basic Sum Assured, Simple Reversionary Bonus (SRB), and Final Additional Bonus (FAB) separately.
Optional Riders Support: Programmed with Accidental Death & Disability Benefit (ADDB), Term Assurance, and Premium Waiver Benefit (PWB) riders.

sections.title: Factors That Affect Your Jeevan Labh Premium

items: Entry Age: Younger policyholders enjoy significantly lower yearly premiums.
Chosen Term & PPT Option: Term 25 / PPT 16 provides the highest total compounding bonuses.
Sum Assured Rebates: LIC grants High Sum Assured (HSA) rebates per ₹1,000 SA for policies above ₹5 Lakh and ₹10 Lakh.
Modal Discounts: Yearly mode gets a 2% rebate on tabular premium; Half-Yearly gets 1% rebate.

items.title: Example 1: Jeevan Labh ₹10 Lakh Sum Assured (Age 30, Term 25)
items.body:

content.text: LIC Jeevan Labh is classified under the Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) category under the old tax regime:

items.title: Section 80C Deduction (Annual Premium Savings)
items.body: Premiums paid up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year qualify for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act.

items.title: Section 10(10D) Tax-Free Maturity
items.body: The entire maturity sum (Sum Assured + SRB + FAB) is 100% tax-free under Section 10(10D), provided annual premium does not exceed 10% of the basic sum assured.

sections.title: Policy Surrender Value & Policy Loan Rules

content.text: Jeevan Labh acquires a guaranteed surrender value after at least two full years of premiums have been paid.

items: Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV): A set percentage of total premiums paid plus vested bonus factor.
Policy Loan Facility: You can take a loan up to 90% of the policy's surrender value for in-force policies (80% for paid-up policies) without terminating the risk cover.

items.q: What is the difference between Plan 936 and Plan 736?
items.a: Plan 736 is the current active UIN version of LIC Jeevan Labh. Plan 936 and Plan 836 were legacy plan numbers for the same limited pay endowment structure. Rates and benefits remain consistent.

items.q: What is the premium for a ₹10 Lakh sum assured in Jeevan Labh?
items.a: For a 30-year-old taking a 25-year term (PPT 16 years), the yearly premium is approximately ₹42,200 including 1st year GST.

items.q: What is the formula for calculating Jeevan Labh maturity amount?
items.a: Maturity Amount = Basic Sum Assured + Accumulated Simple Reversionary Bonuses (SRB) + Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

items.q: What is the Grace Period for Jeevan Labh premium payment?
items.a: LIC allows a Grace Period of 30 days for yearly, half-yearly, and quarterly payment modes, and 15 days for monthly mode.

items.q: What is the Premium Waiver Benefit (PWB) Rider?
items.a: The PWB rider is available for child policies (entry age under 18). If the proposer (parent) passes away during the PPT, all future premiums are waived while the policy continues with full maturity benefits.

sections.title: Conclusion: Why Jeevan Labh is LIC's Top Limited Pay Plan

content.text: LIC Jeevan Labh (Plan 736/936) remains the premier limited pay policy for wealth creation and tax-free lump sum goals. For broader planning, compare with our LIC premium calculator, LIC maturity calculator, and tax regime calculator.
